title: ASTEROIDS / ATARI BUTTONS-ONLY UPRIGHT
variant: Atari black upright with spaceship/planet side art, blue-red operator panel and five shared action buttons
preview_note: 32 x 48 px | Atari black upright with spaceship/planet side art, blue-red operator panel and five shared action buttons

rom_validation.matching: All required files match pinned FBNeo CRC32 and size; existing legacy aliases are accepted.

cabinet.purpose: Photographed Atari upright with black molding, spaceship/orange-blue planets on the side, Asteroids title marquee, striped scene bezel and five-action operator panel. Print restoration status unverified; no Asteroids Deluxe artwork is substituted.
cabinet.rights: Underlying printed artwork Atari; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

marquee.purpose: Original-design title marquee rectified from the cabinet photograph. A separately indexed marquee recreation was not presented as an original scan.
marquee.rights: Underlying printed artwork Atari; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

controls.purpose: Atari blue/red/white operator panel photograph: five white Rotate Left/Right, Hyperspace, Thrust and Fire actions, plus two metal/LED Start buttons. No joystick.
controls.rights: Underlying printed artwork Atari; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

flyer.purpose: Promotional print corroborating Atari Asteroids branding/cabinet; original-versus-reprint physical provenance unverified.
flyer.rights: Underlying printed artwork Atari; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

screen.purpose: Real 640x480 vector-rendered gameplay from supplied rev 4 ROMs and rebuilt classics core: nine-coin state, Start 15 frames, 300 neutral frames. White vector lines retained and brightened only in downsampled sprite texture.
screen.rights: Game imagery Atari, captured from user-supplied local ROM only. No ROM downloaded, uploaded or committed; no redistribution license inferred.

uncertainties: Publisher-hosted artwork masters were not found. Archive photographs/scans are not proof of factory prints or artwork redistribution permission.
This selected shell/kit interpretation is explicit; ROM, hardware and seat count are not changed to suit artwork. No map placement or uploads included.
One photographed side is reused on the opposite side with readable lettering; the distinct opposite factory print is unverified and is not invented.
Asteroids has one shared five-button action panel, not a joystick; its two Start buttons remain photographed in the overlay. Both catalog seats share gameplay while starting separately.
Pinned FBNeo maps 2P Start to player 1 RetroPad R3. The frontend routes seat two Start to that descriptor-defined alias and shares the one coin chute; no new network input format is introduced.
A photographed original-design marquee is used rather than the archive's explicitly named marquee recreation. Publisher master/physical print authenticity remains unverified.

Thin white vectors receive a 3x3 maximum-filter stroke boost before downsampling, then 4x brightness, with black letterboxing and original reference unchanged. The 640x480 capture is rasterized emulated vector output, not replacement pixel art.
The same rebuilt-classics startup-state compatibility note applies as for Space Invaders. Older local Pac-Man/Tetris/Wonder Boy states are backed up, refreshed, and not uploaded automatically.
